purpose: Displays keyboard keys and multi-key shortcuts.
useWhen: Documenting a keyboard key or shortcut.
Showing a shortcut alongside a menu item or help hint.

avoidWhen.situation: The element must capture keyboard input.
avoidWhen.guidance: Kbd is display-only; implement keyboard handling separately.

approvedPatterns: Choose default or inverted to match the surrounding component; both follow the active theme.
limitations: Kbd does not register or handle shortcuts.
Group treatment only propagates to direct Kbd children without their own treatment.
accessibility: Label a shortcut group when the visible glyphs are not self-explanatory.
Mark decorative key icons as hidden from assistive technology.
responsive: Shortcut groups remain inline and do not wrap internally.
rtl: Keys default to lang=en so Latin shortcut labels retain sans typography in Dhivehi contexts.
Set dir=ltr on Latin shortcut groups to preserve modifier-first order in RTL layouts; the group otherwise inherits direction.
